description: This file contains a Spring Batch job configuration class named AcmeNoopJobConfiguration, which defines beans for a no-operation job involving a single step and tasklet, using Spring Batch framework components.

classes.name: AcmeNoopJobConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for a Spring Batch job that performs no operations, assembling job and step beans with injected dependencies.

methods.name: acmeNoopJobStep
methods.description: Defines the step in the job, which executes the specified tasklet using the step builder.

methods.name: acmeNoopJob
methods.description: Defines the main job, which starts with the acmeNoopJobStep and uses a RunIdIncrementer for job parameters.
